v1.5.2 Update
Live Mode dialogue no longer takes its text color and font from another module's chat message styling. Also includes the Clear Speaker button from v1.5.1.

announcement.title: 🌸 Visual Novel Maker v1.5.2
announcement.content:
v1.5.2 fixes Live Mode dialogue taking its text color and font from other chat modules. It also includes the Clear Speaker button from v1.5.1.

  • Text color and font that another module applies to a whole chat message no longer carry into Live Mode dialogue or the Dialogue Backlog. Colors and fonts applied to selected text in the chat input still carry over.
  • From v1.5.1: the Clear Speaker icon button on the character bar returns chat to its default speaker and stops your microphone from triggering character speaking animations until you select a character again. Characters stay on stage. If Character Chat Selector is active, its selection also returns to Default.
